items.label: Standard Size
items.value: Seat height 18inch, back height 24inch, net weight 14.5lbs. This folding rocking chair is different to our oversized type, it's lighter and better to be taken out camping, watching sports and other outdoor activities. And it will also make more people feel comfortable!

items.label: Easy to Assemble and Fold
items.value: There is almost no assembly, and it only takes one person 10s to complete! Once you know the trick, you'll be amazed at its charming folded design! Please refer to the step-by-step diagram and video, or contact us to learn more.

items.label: More Portable
items.value: The unique folding system that folds into a bundle makes the size smaller than a regular foldable rocker. You can straddle it over your shoulder to transport to any places and store away in a corner when not in use.

items.label: 24" Mesh Back & Wide Armrest
items.value: This camping rocking chair is easy in and out. The 24" backrest will support your shoulders very well. The honeycomb mesh back allows cooling air to circulate, with pockets on the side and special cup holders for both big or small cups from tipping over.

items.label: Heavy Duty with Premium Materials
items.value: This patio rocking chair is constructed with a sturdy thickened steel frame and high density polyester. You can absolutely trust its sturdiess and embrace nature and life to the fullest!

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Minimal assembly required, with step-by-step diagram and video provided.
